a: A fact ledger plus Options can repeat scope information for every nested section.
ar: Show only divergent section context in the ledger.
reasonA: Complete access but ledger expansion adds repeated facts.
b: A long context sentence may wrap into a paragraph at 320px.
br: Keep deadline precedence and move optional values into Details.
reasonB: Explicit empty-data and deadline rules reduce the same clutter with less structure.
repair: Limit the synopsis to consequential context; no truncated period labels.

a: Origin rows could make included daily tasks appear overdue.
ar: Label origins as included frequencies rather than missed work.
reasonA: Explains the user's accumulated-work ambiguity directly with actual sources.
b: Quiet context columns still compress a long shared-house title.
br: Use local disclosure at narrow widths.
reasonB: Responsive ledger entails more layout modes without clearer accumulation meaning.
repair: Never use overdue wording for frequency inclusion.

a: Suppressing an inherited date could hide a historical exception.
ar: Suppress only exact context equality; retain uncertain dates.
reasonA: Removes repeated metadata while retaining urgent and uncertain context.
b: One capsule obscures whether changing period also changes inclusion.
br: Separate labelled groups inside and persistent state outside.
reasonB: Repaired capsule preserves access but makes everyday context one step farther away.
repair: Unknown or divergent context remains visible; Details is always explicit.

a: Margin notes create a second scan path for each nested section.
ar: Stack only differing context at mobile widths.
reasonA: Strong history fidelity but weak immediate task prioritization.
b: Disabled Start could leave a user unable to understand eligibility.
br: Retain original eligibility and concise disabled reason.
reasonB: Existing Start keeps resumption direct without introducing new execution logic.
repair: Start remains governed by existing eligible pending tasks.

a: Watermark may look decorative rather than interactive.
ar: Use plain scope text with labelled 44px change control.
reasonA: Persistent scope addresses accidental accumulation assumptions cheaply.
b: Inspector subject may change while an editor is open.
br: Pin identity and guard subject transitions.
reasonB: A shared inspector introduces context synchronization risk absent in the local scope route.
repair: Treat scope as explicit readable state, never a decorative watermark alone.

a: Two 44px disclosures crowd a nested section's short header.
ar: Stack controls and retain scoped Options.
reasonA: Clear distinction but persistent double controls consume mobile space.
b: Repeated Details labels can lose object identity for a screen reader.
br: Name each disclosure with its task or section title.
reasonB: Stable essential spine and local semantic detail preserve predictability across surfaces.
repair: Keep completion separate and give every disclosure an object-specific name.

a: Deletion makes the single inspector reference a stale subject.
ar: Invalidate subject and return focus safely.
reasonA: A new shared selection state adds risk and implementation cost.
b: Explicit scope text may overflow long headings.
br: Wrap controls below the heading, never clip context.
reasonB: Shape plus text improves status clarity without shared inspector state.
repair: Use glass for navigation and opaque readable content fallback.

a: Transaction popover implies confirmation for a boolean inclusion setting.
ar: Retain immediate existing callbacks and explicit page/section names.
reasonA: Useful scope explanation but adds a planning interaction to a simple toggle.
b: A list of many exceptions can refill the gutter.
br: Allow natural wrapping and Details for ordinary metadata.
reasonB: Preserves meaningful exceptions while removing redundant everyday context.
repair: Use selected reference dates rather than today's date for historical warnings.

a: Dedicated deadline row adds height to every dated task.
ar: Render it only for meaningful due context.
reasonA: Deadline editing stays direct and independent of completion.
b: Plan tab conceals task context during repeated scope changes.
br: Pin shared period and inclusion context across tabs.
reasonB: Mode switching adds steps without serving most reading actions.
repair: Keep ordinary date editing reachable in Details even when no urgent row is shown.

a: Typography tiers require learning weight distinctions.
ar: Pair tiers with explicit Propias/Incluidas words.
reasonA: Origin semantics improve but do not resolve metadata volume alone.
b: A synopsis can look like static text.
br: Use persistent chevron, visible focus and explicit disclosure state.
reasonB: Synopsis is both concise context and discoverable access to details.
repair: Do not pack optional fields into the closed synopsis.

a: Reserved rail wastes space when a task has no metadata.
ar: Do not render an empty rail; keep positions stable when populated.
reasonA: Inline metadata rail avoids a new nested modal handoff.
b: Opening a focused editor from an object sheet can lose the original trigger.
br: Coordinate focus handoff and close the intermediary sheet.
reasonB: Full-width targets help mobile but nested sheets add focus and navigation risk.
repair: Re-measure virtualized rows when local details expand.

a: Tabs split history evidence across multiple invisible panels.
ar: Pin period and scope above all tabs.
reasonA: Tab hierarchy increases inspection steps for already-related context.
b: Combined tray may suggest inclusion and date are linked.
br: Separate labelled navigator and scope groups within it.
reasonB: One calm tray groups existing controls with less mode overhead.
repair: Each scope and date control retains its independent callback and state.
